defects: Does not reference `variation` (the supremum-over-partitions definition) at all, so it fails to state the gold's core claim that totalVariation (Jordan decomposition) equals variation (partition supremum)

Instead asserts totalVariation = posPart + negPart, which is essentially an unfolding of the Jordan-decomposition definition of totalVariation, a different (and likely near-trivial/definitional) proposition from the gold

`s.posPart` and `s.negPart` are not standard fields of `SignedMeasure` in Mathlib — pos/neg parts belong to `JordanDecomposition` and are accessed via `s.toJordanDecomposition.posPart`/`negPart`, so the statement may not even elaborate as written
